postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly one space between each pair of characters from the two input strings, with spaces filling gaps if the strings are of unequal length.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == str1[i] if i < len(str1) else ' ' for i in range(len(return_value.split()))) and all(return_value[i+1] == str2[i] if i < len(str2) else ' ' for i in range(len(return_value.split())))
postconditions.description: For each position i in the output, the character at position 2i must match the character at position i in str1 (or a space if str1 is shorter), and the character at position 2i+1 must match the character at position i in str2 (or a space if str2 is shorter).
The total number of spaces in the output must equal the number of missing characters due to unequal string lengths.
